changelog: 0.1.5: the status says plainly why the Stream 100 cannot be read, in English and Spanish (0.1.4 shipped twice, and the first one kept the old wording). 0.1.4: the knobs, the lit buttons, how the knobs turn and the screen are set on the add-on's page with Polaris's own controls, laid out as the controller, in English and Spanish; above them, a preview of what the screen shows. 0.1.1: an editor on the add-on's page shows the controller - what the screen shows, each knob and each lit button - and changes them in place. 0.1.0: each knob follows calls, music, games, the browser or the whole output, with steady steps and no jumps; the lit buttons mute, deafen, turn the camera on or off, or leave the call. Reads the controller on Windows once Windows' own driver is in use, and on Linux where the system lets Polaris open it.
